title: Geometrically connected product factor induces a component bijection
statement: Let $k$ be a field, and let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Assume $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], meaning that $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K$ is nonempty and connected for every field extension $K/k$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Then the projection $q:X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}Y\to Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product] induces a bijection on connected components (maximal nonempty connected subsets of the underlying spaces [def-weil-connected-scheme]), sending a component to the unique component containing its image. No finiteness, separatedness or nonemptiness assumption is imposed on $Y$.
